MMAV glider modelling figures

Figures from the MMAV glider modelling studies, grouped by study. No flight results yet.

1. Flat kit and the plate-balance study

Build drawings of the flat-plate wings (F45 and F60 at 250 mm span, B45 at 400 mm) and plots of the measured plate data (Ananda 2012).

2. Pull-out study

Simulated nose-down drops of the flat-plate wings at different centre-of-gravity positions.

3. Bird outlines: the swift

Designed swift-like wing outlines and the measured chord of real swift wings (Lentink and de Kat 2014).

4. CFD of the Ananda AR 3 plate (Re 60,000)

OpenFOAM results for the Ananda AR 3 rectangular plate, compared with the wind-tunnel data and with AVL.

5. Other figures

Architecture comparisons, AVL baseline curves, earlier XFOIL batch outputs and earlier project figures.
